name: CelesTrak Provider Parser Nodes
description: Pure WASM provider-parser flow nodes for CelesTrak ingest (loop C.8a): parse_gp (GP CSV -> OMM + MPE record streams), parse_satcat (SATCAT fixed-width txt or CSV -> CAT record stream), parse_spw (SW-All.csv -> SPW record stream with the 7-day stale-source gate). Each method joins the request-builder 'job' JSON with the hostcap/http-request 'response' JSON, decodes the payload, computes batch_id = sha256(payload), builds records with the spacedatastandards.org GENERATED C++ code mirroring sdn-server internal/ingest parsing rules and internal/sds builder defaults byte-for-byte, and emits per-schema storage.ingest_with_source metas (attribution, reconcile mode, archive naming, licence/citation and upstream origin from the job, wasm-authored provenance JSON) plus size-prefixed record streams and the raw payload for archiving. Response validators are read under every host spelling (etag/Etag/ETag, last-modified/Last-Modified, content-type/Content-Type, date/Date) so the provenance record always carries them. HTTP 304 Not Modified is accepted: the method emits a single notice on its 'unchanged' port and nothing else, so no batch is stored or announced. No capabilities: this node performs no I/O.

methods.description: Parses a CelesTrak GP CSV payload into OMM + MPE record streams with full provenance metas. BATCHING: every input port here is single-stream BY CONTRACT and that is now ENFORCED IN CODE, not merely declared. maxStreams/maxBatch/drainPolicy are purely DECLARATIVE in the compiled flow runtime - space_data_module_runtime_begin_node_invocation pops the node whole queue port-blind up to the drain budget (64) - so a node that read ordinal 0 of a port and returned used to destroy every other frame it was handed there, with nothing re-delivering them and nothing logging the loss (live P1 cellular-multiprovider-returns-only-first-provider). A surplus is now refused with error code "batched-input-frames", naming the port and the count. See graph task modules-guest-nodes-drop-batched-frames.

methods.description: Parses CelesTrak EOP-All.csv (DATE,MJD,X,Y,UT1-UTC,LOD,DPSI,DEPS,DX,DY,DAT,DATA_TYPE) into an $EOP record stream: arcsecond columns to radians in the authoritative double-precision _HP fields with float32 copies, DAT to TAI_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS, DATA_TYPE O/P, SERIES FINALS2000A, IAU_2000A, DATA_SET_EPOCH from Last-Modified; enforces the 7-day stale-source gate on the newest OBSERVED row; reconcile "current" because each fetch is the whole history and supersedes the previous snapshot. BATCHING: every input port here is single-stream BY CONTRACT and ENFORCED IN CODE; a surplus is refused with error code "batched-input-frames" (see graph task modules-guest-nodes-drop-batched-frames).
